class.name: RenderingQuality
class.brief_description: One quality ladder (Low, Medium, High, Ultra) for every rendering setting, by group.
class.description: An overall level sets every group (textures, geometry, shadows, path tracing, reflections, volumetrics, vegetation, effects, post-processing); a group may then be moved on its own. Each group level is a table of project settings: the engine registers its own, and a project or a system registers more with [method register_setting]. High keeps every setting as the project has it, Ultra goes above it (full meshes at every distance), Medium and Low trade detail for speed and memory. A game's options menu maps onto [method set_level] and [method set_group_level]. The ladder only applies when the project runs, never in the editor, and never saves project settings. [codeblock] RenderingQuality.set_level(RenderingQuality.LEVEL_MEDIUM) RenderingQuality.set_group_level(RenderingQuality.GROUP_TEXTURES, RenderingQuality.LEVEL_ULTRA) RenderingQuality.register_setting(RenderingQuality.GROUP_VEGETATION, "game/vegetation/density", [0.25, 0.5, null, null]) [/codeblock]

method.name: apply_project_settings
method.description: Reads [member ProjectSettings.rendering/quality/level] and [code]rendering/quality/groups/*[/code] and applies them. Runs once at startup.

method.name: get_effective_group_level
method.description: The level [param group] renders at: its own level, or the overall level when it follows it.

method.name: get_group_level
method.description: The level set for [param group], or [code]-1[/code] when it follows the overall level.

method.name: get_group_settings
method.description: Each setting of [param group] and the value it has at [param level].

method.name: register_setting
method.description: Makes the project setting [param setting] scale with [param group]: [param values] holds one value per level, Low to Ultra, and [code]null[/code] keeps the project's own value at that level. Registering a setting again replaces its row.

method.name: set_group_level
method.description: Sets [param group] to [param level] alone; [code]-1[/code] makes it follow the overall level again.

method.name: set_level
method.description: Sets the overall level and applies it to every group that follows it.

method.name: unregister_setting
method.description: Stops [param setting] scaling with its group and restores the project's value.

signal.name: group_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a group's settings were applied at [param level]. Systems that scale in their own way (not through a project setting) listen to it.

signal.name: level_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the overall level changes.

constants.constant: Every setting as the project has it.
Above the project's settings: full meshes at every distance, no texture cap.
